scope: New orchestration only; existing qualified raw/shape/source/claim/impact/context/reading quotas remain independently enforced. This is not a wholepipeline measured counter, allocation proof, Python instruction count or native proof.
metadata: L_core is actual Request+Envelope+Body byte lengths, each already bounded. L_core is no larger than the frozen full metadata L. Using this narrower allowance cannot enlarge the admitted wholemetadata work ceiling.

coverage: Fixed orchestration metadata scans, exact identity derivation, canonical serialization, array construction and final result preparation. Every new collection is bounded by the closed schema or MAX_TARGETS1024; no traversal discovers new roots.

Sorting metadata uses only bounded sets: at most96 records, at most64 dependencies, at most32 withdrawal records, at most16 source keys. Canonical serializations are bounded by their admitted bytes; the conservative sort portion reserves96 linear metadata passes, plus32 passes for fixed scans/construction. Component-internal sorting/work remains under its separate source-bound quotas.
The Source DAG completion flags scan is charged separately; path enumeration retains its existing work/path/depth/output caps.

additional_charges: Each typed target incidence is charged1+actualRecordIndexCount+actualClaimIndexCount+actualSourceKeyCount before dictionary target lookup. This conservatively pays candidate comparisons despite indexed lookup.
Each guard position node is charged1+ownedDependencyCount before bounded role search, for Claim and selected source separately.
Each distinct parsed DeclarationSource is charged its actual byte length before its already bounded strict parser; the source is cached once, while perClaim selection eligibility is retained.

Each source edge insertion is charged1; every DAG round reserves actualSourceCount cells for each vertex before the single cell loop; completion flag scans charge actualSourceCount. Fixed225-byte matrix,15 rank slots and15 flags; maximum15 rounds. Cycles never return accepted prefix.
fixed_scan_inventory: derived claim ID pass<=16 and update duplicate pass<=8
record pin set<=96 and dedicated static pin arrays<=16+32
source key set<=16; all physical aliases charged independently
typed field extraction<=1024 incidences per bounded root
target resolution<=1024; selected source guard incidence<=15*(32+32)
read-ahead Claim pass<=16 and selector membership indexes<=32; source parsing cached by full key
typed kind closure and fixed field group references
withdrawal predecessor pass<=32; Update predecessor pass<=8
history related IDs bounded by closed schema
typed rank pass<=1024; fixed source DAG separate
final Claim joins<=16; result-size accounting per entry; fulloutput<=131072
failure: Counter exhaustion produces REFUSED_BYTE_BOUND/WORK_BOUND with no accepted dimensions. Existing complete path/output limits produce REFUSED_COMPLETE_OUTPUT_BOUND. No capacities are raised.
assurance: Source-reviewed conservative engineering reservation; not formal whole-runtime bound. Existing parser/output/file/installer caps remain controlling.
